passages.note: Assembly Floor concurrence vote page names Kalra in the Ayes list with a 44-33 tally, a single-subject vote not near-unanimous.

passages.provision_quote: the quantities shall reflect reasonable progress in each of the intervening years sufficient to ensure that the procurement of electricity products from eligible renewable energy resources achieves 25 percent of retail sales by December 31, 2016, 33 percent by December 31, 2020, 44 percent by December 31, 2024, 52 percent by December 31, 2027, and 60 percent by December 31, 2030.
passages.note: The amended Pub. Util. Code section 399.15 binds retail sellers to procure renewable energy at fixed percentages by firm dates, matching rung 1's mandate-plus-deadline clauses.

rows.reasoning: SB 100 (2017-2018) amends Pub. Util. Code section 399.15 to require retail sellers to procure renewable energy to binding dated percentages (44% by December 31, 2024; 60% by December 31, 2030), matching rung 1's 'mandates and firm deadlines'; Kalra voted Aye on the single-subject Assembly Floor concurrence (44-33), a record within his own Assembly tenure.
